disclaimer: ILLUSTRATIVE - SIMULATED. Deterministic recovery projections for population health planning only.

CRITICAL_UNACK.title: Critical Abnormal Result Unacknowledged (>24h)
CRITICAL_UNACK.description: Patient with critical lab breach (e.g. HbA1c > 11.0%) has not opened notification or completed teach-back within 24 hours.

REFERRAL_REJECTED.title: Specialist Referral Rejected / Returned
REFERRAL_REJECTED.description: Hospital endocrinology clinic returned referral due to capacity cap or missing preliminary records; escrow held at referring GP.

MISSING_DOCS.title: Missing Clinical Verification Documents
MISSING_DOCS.description: Specialist triage blocked due to absence of secondary fasting glucose or retinal baseline imaging.

NO_SLOT.title: No Participating Clinic Slot Available (<30 Days)
NO_SLOT.description: Primary receiving facility has zero consultation slots within guideline SLA target.

LANGUAGE_BARRIER.title: Language / Health Literacy Disparity Detected
LANGUAGE_BARRIER.description: Patient failed digital teach-back or indicated non-Arabic/English preferred dialect.

REPEAT_MSG.name: Targeted Multichannel Re-notification
REPEAT_MSG.description: Dispatch high-contrast SMS + interactive WhatsApp prompt with simplified audio prompt attachment.
assumptions: Patient has active cellular reception and SMS capability

INTERPRETER_CALL.name: Bilingual Coordinator Voice Consultation
INTERPRETER_CALL.description: Care Navigator initiates structured 15-minute phone call in patient's preferred language with verbal teach-back.
assumptions: Navigator fluent in patient preferred dialect (Arabic/Urdu/Hindi)
Call scheduled during preferred contact window
Verbal teach-back recorded directly into audit chain

CHW_VISIT.name: In-Person CHW Home Assisted Visit
CHW_VISIT.description: Community Health Worker dispatches to patient residence with secure field tablet for in-person consultation and mobility check.
assumptions: Patient resides in designated primary care service catchment
Tablet offline sync validated with DoH telemetry hub
Transportation barrier assessed with immediate voucher eligibility

DOC_RECOVERY.name: Expedited Document & Lab Recovery Protocol
DOC_RECOVERY.description: Automated query across clinic repository and electronic query to primary laboratory to bridge missing pre-requisites.
assumptions: Previous screening records exist in participating laboratory network
Clinician digital sign-off completed within 12 hours

ALT_PROVIDER.name: Capacity-Aware Alternate Provider Re-routing
ALT_PROVIDER.description: Identify partner specialty clinic with open slot within 14 days and travel distance < 20km; maintain referral escrow until accepted.
assumptions: Partner facility accepts DoH Thiqa/Basic insurance network
Referring GP retains escrow accountability until receiving clinic accepts
